summary: Implemented Ledger.total: approved entries of the tenant, summed, rounded to 2dp half away from zero.

criteria.criterion: Approved 0.005 alone totals 0.01; approved -0.005 alone totals -0.01
criteria.test: total rounds approved 0.005 to 0.01; total rounds approved -0.005 to -0.01

criteria.criterion: Unapproved entries and other tenants' entries do not count
criteria.test: total ignores unapproved and other tenants

summary: Implemented Ledger.approve with ordered checks (isActive, Approver role, tenant-scoped lookup, self-approval, already approved).

criteria.criterion: A session idle for exactly 15 minutes can approve; at 15 minutes 1 second it gets SessionExpired
criteria.test: approve allows session idle exactly 15 minutes; approve rejects session idle 15 minutes 1 second

criteria.criterion: An Admin without Approver gets NotAuthorized
criteria.test: approve Admin without Approver is NotAuthorized

summary: Implemented Ledger.view: SessionExpired if inactive, else own-tenant entries in original order for every role.

criteria.criterion: An Admin of t1 sees only t1 entries
criteria.test: view Admin sees only own tenant in order
